verdict.rationale: Paddle's core product is subscription billing, which is inherently a recurring workflow — subscriptions auto-charge on cycles, and dunning/Tactical Retries auto-retry failed payments over a 30-day window — and AI agents can create/manage these recurring billing objects via the API/MCP server (docs-mcp-1, mcp-server, dunning). However this is domain-specific recurring billing automation, not a general-purpose 'schedule any recurring job/workflow' capability for AI agents; there's no evidence of a scheduler for arbitrary agent-defined recurring tasks beyond billing cycles. Missing for 10: general-purpose recurring job/workflow scheduling API, evidence of AI agents defining custom cron-like automations, independent corroboration of this being used for non-billing recurring workflows.
